comment: A live-session message's default delivery is now "steer" instead of "queue" when the caller omits --delivery / the delivery field entirely -- this covers ACP-interop relays and other agent-to-agent sends that posted directly against the live-messages API. Queueing behind a busy session's current turn could take a very long time to reach the receiver; steering injects at the running turn's next step instead. Pass --delivery queue (or delivery="queue") explicitly to opt back into end-of-turn delivery.
